notes.title: Let's Play: Sweet Science, the award-winning visual novel!
notes.content:
Sweet Science – The Girls of Silversee Castle
Travel back to the 1990s to a mysterious boarding school, meet four nerdy girls, go on adventures, find the way back to your time – or maybe win the heart of your dream girl!
We'll play the first day of this visual novel where you will meet Azuki, the spaced-out anime girl, Marie, the timid, super smart child protegee, Patti, who doesn't miss a chance to set something on fire, and Baroness Sylvia who anyway feels way above you minor creatures...
We're going to have loads of fun together, so don't forget to tune into this stream!

https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2309230/ss_13f74dbb37380d3c27da9a8cca158621df1f82c8.1920x1080.jpg?t=1714359108

Get "Sweet Science" now for free on Steam, but also check out our new game The Beautiful Island!
